messages.author: Ibrahim Mohamed
messages.body: Greetings sir,I built and installed Ambertools20 but when i tried to run this command:$amberhome/parmed-master/parmed.pyit gave me this error:/parmed-master/parmed.py: No such file or directoryHow can I solve this? And Is this the right command to use parmed.py?Thanks

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Jun 21, 2020, Ibrahim Mohamed wrote:
>Greetings sir,I built and installed Ambertools20 but when i tried to
>run this command:$amberhome/parmed-master/parmed.pyit gave me this
>error:/parmed-master/parmed.py: No such file or directoryHow can I solve
>this? And Is this the right command to use parmed.py?Thanks
To "run" parmed from the command line, use $AMBERHOME/bin/parmed (no
".py" extension).
...good luck...dac
